purpose: Candidate-only, fail-closed extraction of the exact legacy motif lexeme census stored in phase2_pubchem_ready.lmdb. This contract does not approve a P1/P2 vocabulary union or any training admission.

source_format.payload_identity: canonical positive-decimal PubChem CID key equals str(payload['cid'])
source_format.metadata_policy: Only source-lock-enumerated metadata keys may exist; any other non-payload key aborts the whole extraction.

legacy_pickle_boundary.rule: The complete LMDB file SHA-256 and byte count must match the source lock before the first pickle.loads call and must match again after the read transaction closes.

motif_sequence.envelope: After preserving counts of optional top-level whitespace, the sequence is exactly <bom> followed by bracket-depth-delimited units followed by <eom>.
motif_sequence.component_ranges: zero-based half-open ranges over non-separator fragments

projection.algorithm: Delete every valid anchor lexeme from the exact fragment without any other normalization, then wrap the remaining exact UTF-8 core in one outer square-bracket pair.

legacy_anchor_observation.interpretation: P2 labels are measured as legacy component-local attachment labels; they are not interpreted as P1 global cross-motif bond IDs.
legacy_anchor_observation.p1_pair_rule: For measurement only, each anchor label has multiplicity exactly two inside one stored component.
legacy_anchor_observation.p1_pair_rule_failure_disposition: admit_and_report; never reject solely for this legacy semantic difference

record_validation.atom_to_motif_map_schema: non-empty outer list/tuple of non-empty list/tuple groups containing nonnegative integral scalars excluding booleans; values are normalized to Python integers only for hashing
record_validation.cardinality: number of non-separator motif fragments equals len(atom_to_motif_map)

row_order.reject_ledger.jsonl: source key bytes ascending rejected subset
row_order.record_projection.jsonl: source key bytes ascending admitted subset

artifacts.record_projection_privacy: contains hashes, ordered exact-lexeme digests, component ranges and aggregate measurements; does not repeat raw fragments, SMILES, coordinates, descriptions or E3FP arrays
artifacts.determinism: A second fresh process with a different PYTHONHASHSEED must reproduce the six non-receipt artifacts byte-for-byte and the same logical_derivation_sha256.

fail_closed: The output directory must be new and is never overwritten.
Source file, contract, source lock, extractor and producer/spec provenance are content addressed.
LMDB entry count must equal expected payload count plus the exact metadata-key count.
Membership must partition every payload key into exactly one admitted or rejected disposition.
Digest-to-distinct-fragment and pure-digest-to-distinct-token collisions abort the whole extraction.
The derivation receipt is written last and cannot claim training admission or a P1/P2 union decision.
